# ShopHub

> ShopHub is an online shopping destination for electronics, fashion, home essentials and more, with curated collections, secure payments, fast delivery, easy returns, plus a rewards lucky-draw and quiz program.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured deals, categories and new arrivals.
- [Products](/products): Browse the full catalog with filters, search and categories.
- [Blog](/blog): Shopping guides, product roundups and tips.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, phone and contact form for customer support.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Site terms of use.
- [Refunds & Cancellations](/refunds): Return, refund and cancellation policy.

## Rewards

- [Lucky Draw](/lucky-draw): Reward program with periodic prize draws.
- [Contest Rules](/lucky-draw/rules): Eligibility and rules for the rewards program.
- [Quiz](/quiz): Play quizzes to earn extra rewards.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
